messages:
maria-cs: quick heads-up — Hightide Health wants a temporary 'quick lift' for a UK demo next Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC. They're asking for a QPS bump and UK-edge allowlisting so latency is solid for clinicians. renewal is flagged as at-risk unless demo goes smoothly. can we action?
ben-sre: got it. are they on Hosted or Dedicated? need org id, desired qps, and CIDRs to whitelist. also what fallback do we want if capacity gets tight? @ops-oncall FYI.
maria-cs: Hosted (payg). org id org-htd-47. requested peak qps = 1,800 (current baseline ~200). CIDRs: 34.72.10.0/24, 34.72.11.0/24. timeframe next Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC (3h). they prefer UK region routing if possible. renewal meeting Wed 14:00 UTC — success here is critical.
rachel-platform: we can route to the London edge (eu-west-2) and add the CIDRs to proxy allowlist. note: Hosted customers auto-fall back to multi-region; for a hard route to uk-edge we need a transient routing policy and peering pin. for 1,800 qps for 3h we should be fine but need to reserve burst capacity.
sam-support: i'll prepare a short runbook + health dashboard for the window and enable expanded logs for the session. add a realtime slack alert to #release-war-room. would like to enable a few eval prompts to monitor quality during the demo.
ben-sre: tentative plan: create a temporary rate-policy and allowlist entry, start with a soft-limit at 2k qps and a circuit-breaker at 2.5k. i'll also add path-based routing to prefer eu-west-2 for this org. snippet i'll apply:
```json
{
  "org_id": "org-htd-47",
  "temp_policy": {
    "start": "2026-03-31T09:00:00Z",
    "end": "2026-03-31T12:00:00Z",
    "max_qps": 2000,
    "circuit_break_qps": 2500
  },
  "allowlist": ["34.72.10.0/24", "34.72.11.0/24"]
}
```
ben-sre: tagging infra-bot to create the ticket and auto-provision the policy. @ops-oncall can you confirm we have headroom in London for that window?
infra-bot: ticket #CS-8742 created -> temp policy + allowlist request. assigned to ben-sre. policy will auto-revoke at end time.
ops-oncall: confirmed — we have spare capacity in eu-west-2 for that 3h window, will reserve burst nodes. please ensure telemetry and token-level traces are enabled for org-htd-47.
jake-ae: i'll join the demo and the renewal call Wed 14:00 UTC. i'll surface this as a win in the renewal if demo metrics look good. maria, do they have a success metric (p95 latency < 250ms or X completions)?
maria-cs: they want p95 < 300ms and no errors for the core clinician flows. i'll share a 3-step checklist with them (prewarm, demo traffic ramp plan, test prompts).
ben-sre: i'll push the config today and post the policy id here when ready. quick ask: please make sure customer rotates any long-lived keys and uses ephemeral keys for the demo session.
maria-cs: noted — i'll send instructions. thanks team :heart: :thumbsup:
ben-sre: policy pushed -> policy_id=tmp-htd-47-20260331. allowlist applied. monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-htd-47/session-20260331
sam-support: dashboard shared with Hightide; runbook uploaded to CS drive. i'll add a post-demo feedback form to capture UX and any edge-case logs.
ops-oncall: will stand by during the window, channel set to #release-war-room and i'll post hourly check-ins.
maria-cs: perfect — i'll coordinate with the customer for prewarm at 08:45 UTC. everyone please flag any blockers ASAP.
